english.title: Advertise for recruits for a clinical trial without authority

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Medicines for human Use Clinical Trials Regulations 2004

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) issued an advertisement for the purpose of recruiting individuals to be participants in a clinical trial when the conditions in regulation 12(3)(a) of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 were not satisfied
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(2)(b), 49(1)(aa) and 52 of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 51 of the of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 provides a defence of due diligence.
(ii) This offence applies from the 28th April 2026 due to changes made by the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) (Amendment) Regulations 2025. For the offence applicable before this date, see H11747.
